posts.caption:

posts.title: Fired for Speaking Up: Leadership After
posts.caption:
LEADERSHIP AFTER.

Getting fired does not end the leadership test. It starts a different one. A leader who loses the room has to decide what he carries next. He kept the ledger, he kept the receipts, and he kept showing up for the work. The next job is not revenge. It is building something that outlasts the room that cut you out. Document the decision, name the standard, and let the next room be one you built on purpose.

What a leader does next. Follow @davidsicairos_.

posts.title: ILLEGALLY FIRED: Atwater Angle
posts.caption:
ATWATER ANGLE.

A district decision does not stay inside a boardroom. In Atwater, it lands in classrooms and at kitchen tables. In his account, a counselor is fired seven days after a public post. Families ask who speaks for their kids on Monday morning. Teachers cover the gap, parents hear the rumor before the record, and trust gets rebuilt one honest conversation at a time. That is why the record matters here, not the rumor.
